_doc: Golden set for T04. `kind` governs what may be claimed from it.
'measured'         — >=60 entries (40 football, 20 tennis) from a real board, each
hand-labelled against sofascore.com, with the raw
request->response payloads embedded. ONLY a file with this kind
may be quoted as the E4 precision measurement.
'partial_measured' — every entry below is backed by a raw payload recorded in
docs/sofa/evidence/, but there are far fewer than 60 and
tennis's search half is uncovered. Precision computed here is a
regression guard, NOT the AC of E4.

ac_status.blocker: Sofascore answers HTTP 403 'challenge' from the build host, so a real board cannot be walked. Every entry here comes from a payload recorded on 2026-09-17, before the block.

entries.note: Right team, right day, wrong opponent. This is the failure that costs money: a match to ANOTHER fixture of the same team is indistinguishable from success in a recall-only file like per_fixture_match_test.json.
No /search/all payload was ever recorded for this player, so this entry exercises event matching from a verified entity onward and NOT the search half.
